description: This file contains the source code for the `Attribute` class within the `Opencart\Admin\Model\Catalog` namespace. It implements methods for managing product attributes in the OpenCart e-commerce system, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving attribute data and descriptions from the database.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Model class for handling product attribute data, including CRUD operations and descriptions management.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Creates a new attribute record in the database and adds associated descriptions for different languages.

methods.name: editAttribute
methods.description: Updates an existing attribute record and its descriptions based on attribute ID.

methods.name: deleteAttribute
methods.description: Removes an attribute and its descriptions from the database.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Fetches a single attribute record, including its description for the current language.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves multiple attribute records, optionally filtered by criteria, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalAttributes
methods.description: Returns the total count of attribute records in the database.

methods.name: getTotalAttributesByAttributeGroupId
methods.description: Returns the total number of attributes within a specific attribute group.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a specific attribute ID and language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific attribute ID.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all attribute descriptions for a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute description based on attribute ID and language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a given attribute ID, across languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all attribute descriptions for a specific language.
